treatment.construction: public Newton ModelBuilder.add_constraint_mimic plus public ModelBuilder.add_custom_values; no import from Newton _src
treatment.mimic_target_kind_basis: Newton 1.6.1 public custom schema; MjcEqualityTargetKind enum is not public in the installed version
treatment.retained_actuators: all original 14 per-wheel PI actuators and per-wheel 2 Nm caps; this is still not a single motor-per-side drivetrain model

pre_motion_gate.all_12_follower_leader_pairs: exact expected joint1=follower, joint2=leader, polycoef=[0,1,0,0,0], target-kind=2, target=mimic index, enabled=true
pre_motion_gate.solver_values: host MuJoCo and MJWarp arrays must both match before motion; stop if schema propagation fails

acceptance.yaw: measure only; no target yaw rate

source_policy.v4: frozen; only import and checked in-memory collector wrapping

run_policy: One CPU schema preflight and one authorized motion case only. If residual thresholds fail, report residual distribution and actual equality metadata; do not tune further without parent decision.
